attribution: Data: nflverse (nflverse.com) player_stats -- free, permissive; built with numpy, no third-party data libs
normalization: per-game rates, z-scored within season across QB/RB/WR/TE (context-honest)
coords: PCA-3 of the 18-d per-game rate profile v, z-scored within season. Copied from the export and independently reproduced by scripts/build_gridiron_map.py at |r| = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] on x/y/z.
coords_are_not: a projection of the trained model's embedding. That is a separate artifact, assets/embedding.json: MTNN v2 gated-fusion 32-d, PCA-3, 503 players, 2025 season only.

cosine_distribution.note: cosine between two randomly chosen player-seasons in the 18-d v space, over a deterministic stride sample
